author_layer.counting_rule: wc -m over author-owned runtime HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; UTF-8 decoded characters including newlines
excluded: baseline manifests, browser harness, screenshots, and this report
author_layer.tradeoff: The only shorter baseline JavaScript was a 5450-character single line with one-letter identifiers. The candidate deliberately pays the formatting and semantic-name cost needed for Agent readability; HTML, CSS, and binary dependencies remain byte-identical. No whitespace minification or identifier mangling was used.

readability_changes: Expanded the one-line application into conventional two-space blocks with domain names such as PreviewController, productButtons, activeButton, reducedMotion, and buildTimeline.
Made grid construction, preview construction, mask geometry, GSAP choreography, gallery cycling, input state, responsive fit, loading, and teardown separate readable units.
Centralized abortable event registration through one named listen helper so lifecycle ownership is visible at each input binding.
Named image readiness and hover-intent state instead of embedding them in the startup expression.
Removed the unused stage DOM lookup and unused per-controller productIds property; neither participated in rendering or behavior.
Kept the implementation compact enough that only the exact 12-point polygon formula exceeds 120 columns; it is 260 source lines and is not minified.

cross_audit.revision: Added a disposed boundary to the staging candidate. Before the fix, a caller holding a cached __cover object could call open() after pagehide and restore active/ARIA state; pagehide also left the current button pressed. Teardown now closes the active preview before disposal and cached open/close methods are inert.
cross_audit.readability: Readable-compact for a DOM/GSAP interaction of this size. The 364-character maximum is the single exact 12-point clip-path formula; all state, timelines, product data, inputs and teardown use semantic names. No minification or needless explanatory blocks were found.

independent_evidence.runtime: zero console, page, failed-request, HTTP or external-request errors

cross_audit.symlink_and_http: The baseline pages link and candidate media/vendor links resolve within the formal sample and served successfully over HTTP. Candidate HTML/CSS are independent author copies; unchanged media/vendor remain hash-identical.
cross_audit.fallback: All 24 media files, local font and local GSAP asset loaded. The existing image readiness path releases the loading state on either load or error; no new substitute media was introduced because fixed composition fidelity depends on the bundled source assets.
cross_audit.remaining_risk: The sample intentionally has a large binary media dependency; that is excluded from author tokens but remains a runtime packaging cost.
